title: Top 15 largest state-budget sections in 2025
notes: Uses budget_items_data.amount_allocated for 2025 main budget sections only (level = 1), excluding TOTAL, to avoid double-counting child budget items.
query: SELECT code, title, amount_allocated, amount_revised, amount_used, item_url FROM budget_items_data WHERE year = 2025 AND level = 1 AND code <> 'TOTAL' ORDER BY amount_allocated DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15
